access: Confirm the systems and users in scope
Check sampled access against current job responsibilities
Record inappropriate or unconfirmed access as Findings
vendor: Confirm service criticality and data/access exposure
Examine current assurance and its covered period
Record assurance gaps and follow-up owners
policy: Identify the policy version and accountable owner
Check whether the policy remains appropriate and approved
Record required changes and approval follow-up
risk: Reassess likelihood and impact using current conditions
Examine treatment progress and acceptance expiry
Record changed exposure and decisions required
default: Confirm the practice and period being examined
Examine evidence or document why none is required
Record the conclusion, Findings, and required follow-up
